component.name: Minecraft Pocket Edition Launcher
component.summary: Import a local Android APK and launch it with mcpelauncher

description.p: Unofficial GPLv3 fork of mcpelauncher-ui-qt focused only on local APK import and launching.
This app does not include Minecraft, APKs, extracted game libraries, game assets, or Mojang/Microsoft files. Users must provide their own legally obtained APK.
This project is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, Google, or the upstream mcpelauncher maintainers.
Adds named, isolated instances, storage management, launcher patches, and the redesigned interface.
